entries.name: finish + save (Esc)
entries.purpose: The REFIT primary button: finish build mode, persist the new station layout, re-bake the live world, and resume the sim.
entries.promise: Clicking DONE (or Esc) closes REFIT, saves the layout, and any capability props placed this session stay online in the live world after the re-bake.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-done/closes+persists — after DONE, World.heroCaps still holds the placed workbench cap through the re-bake.

entries.name: frame the station
entries.purpose: Camera affordance: reframe the REFIT canvas so the whole station is centred and visible.
entries.promise: Clicking FIT (or F) recomputes zoom/pan from station bounds so the built station is framed inside the viewport.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-fit/reframes. UX-only (no truth-bearing state); no dedicated machine assertion => KNOWN finding b46cf4ac (stays audited, not perfected, per EL-3 no-unguarded-promise law).

entries.name: ▸ START BUILDING
entries.purpose: The first-use guide dismiss button: closes the BUILD YOUR STATION coach card and marks it seen so it never re-nags.
entries.promise: Clicking START BUILDING removes the .refit-guide card and persists the seen flag (localStorage), returning to the live grid.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-help/guide+start — the START BUILDING button is present with correct label and dismisses. Shares KNOWN uncovered-UX finding b46cf4ac.

entries.name: how to build
entries.purpose: Opens the build-mode field guide: a first-use coach card explaining rooms, halls, props, belts, and the BAY->agent loop.
entries.promise: Clicking HELP shows the .refit-guide card with the build instructions and a START BUILDING dismiss button.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-help/guide+start PASS. UX-only; no dedicated machine assertion => KNOWN finding b46cf4ac.

entries.name: redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)
entries.purpose: Redo the last undone build mutation, re-applying it (including any capability it re-grants).
entries.promise: Clicking REDO (or Ctrl+Shift+Z) re-applies the last undone station change; redoing a reclaimed cap-prop brings its real capability back online.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-redo/regrants-cap — redo after undo re-adds the workbench and World.heroCaps regains workbench. Machine-guarded by worldmodel undo/redo round-trip test.

entries.name: send test work down your belts — watch it sort to the bays (no bot needed)
entries.purpose: Sends test work down the placed belts so the sort-to-bays loop can be watched without a live agent run.
entries.promise: Clicking TEST spawns narrated test boxes that travel the belt runs and sort into bays (a dry-run of the conveyor loop).
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-test/fires — button fires without throwing. The animated belt demo has no golden/journey guard => KNOWN finding b46cf4ac (stays audited).

entries.name: undo (Ctrl+Z)
entries.purpose: Undo the last build mutation, restoring prior station state (and REVOKING any capability that placement granted).
entries.promise: Clicking UNDO (or Ctrl+Z) reverts the last station change; undoing a placed cap-prop takes its real capability back offline (place=grant, undo=revoke).
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-undo/revokes-cap — after undo, World.heroCaps no longer holds workbench. Truthful inverse of place-grants-cap. Machine-guarded by worldmodel undo/redo round-trip test.

entries.name: Read the recipe
entries.purpose: The "Read the recipe" expand glyph (▸) on a recipe card — reveals the full recipe body inline, exactly what the run is told (no divergence).
entries.promise: Clicking the ▸ toggles the card open (glyph -> ▾) and shows the recipe <pre> body that /api/skills already returned; the body shown == the body compose() injects into the run.

coverage.ref: ledger:11c69e21 (EL-3 coverage gap — no journey/test guards this promise; live-proven this session)

entries.notes: Live: 24 expand buttons (title="Read the recipe") rendered in the library; bodies ship in the /api/skills payload so expand needs no 2nd fetch. live-proven 2026-07-07 via scratchpad/drive-skills.mjs on seeded :8965/CDP:9365 — see finding 11c69e21 evidence

entries.name: CLICK one machine, then another — the belt lays itself · (or drag to lay tiles by hand)  (7)
entries.purpose: BELT mode (7): wire machines together — click one machine then another and the belt lays itself.
entries.promise: With BELT selected, clicking one machine then another lays a belt run; complete INBOX->BAY->OUTBOX lines glow, broken pieces are flagged in words.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-modes/7-hints — belt tool present, hint CLICK one machine, then another (7); reclaim setup laid a 3-belt run via placeBeltRun. Machine-covered in conveyor + worldmodel belt tests.

entries.name: Turn ON this skill station-wide

entries.promise: Reads OFF (aria-checked=false); clicking it POSTs /api/skills/toggle {enabled:true} and the panel reloads showing ON, with GET /api/skills reading back enabled:true.

coverage.ref: ledger:11c69e21 (EL-3 coverage gap — no journey/test guards this promise; live-proven this session)

entries.notes: Live: 33 OFF switches on a bare seed; toggle round-trip verified truthful (same POST/reload path as the ON case). live-proven 2026-07-07 via scratchpad/drive-skills.mjs on seeded :8965/CDP:9365 — see finding 11c69e21 evidence

entries.name: Turn OFF this skill station-wide
entries.purpose: The per-recipe ON/OFF switch in its ON state — the user's station-wide choice to enable a library recipe (distinct from the floor grant).
entries.promise: Reads ON (aria-checked=true); clicking it POSTs /api/skills/toggle {enabled:false}, persists to skillPrefs, and the panel reloads showing OFF — and GET /api/skills reads back enabled:false (truthful: the switch mirrors real persisted prefs, which feed the run-path compose()).

coverage.ref: ledger:11c69e21 (EL-3 coverage gap — no journey/test guards this promise; live-proven this session)

entries.notes: Live round-trip: flipped decision-1-3-1 -> DOM sk-switch off/aria-checked=false/label OFF AND GET /api/skills enabled=false; re-flip restored enabled=true. Switch=user choice mirrors persisted prefs; compose() gates the run by the SAME isEnabled&&isAvailable (dossier-SKILLS-honesty law holds). live-proven 2026-07-07 via scratchpad/drive-skills.mjs on seeded :8965/CDP:9365 — see finding 11c69e21 evidence

entries.purpose: PROP mode (6): place furniture/gear; a functional prop = a REAL capability grant (object=capability).
entries.promise: With PROP selected, clicking the grid places the chosen prop; placing a capability prop brings the matching real tool capability online for the agent whose room it lands in.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): truthful/place-grants-cap — placeCapProp(workbench) makes World.heroCaps gain workbench; undo revokes it. Prop tile shows the truthful grant word (comms_dish -> WEB). Guarded by audit moat + prop-place and worldmodel bayObjects test.

entries.name: click a room, prop, or belt to tear it down · drag across a belt to clear the whole run (UNDO restores it)  (5)
entries.purpose: RECLAIM mode (5): tear down a room, prop, or belt; drag across a belt to clear the whole run in one undo slot.
entries.promise: A click removes the room/prop/belt under it; a drag across belts clears the whole run — UNDO restores it. Reclaiming a cap-prop revokes its capability.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-reclaim/drag-clear-one-undo — a 3-belt run cleared to 0 and ONE undo restored all 3 (belt-reclaim one-undo-slot law, 7/06). removeProp+undo and one-undo belt removal machine-covered in worldmodel/conveyor tests.

entries.promise: With ROOM selected, dragging a rectangle adds a room (green=ok/red=blocked); the hint text names the gesture and key.
entries.notes: Live-proven (.uiatlas/build2-evidence/refit-verify.json): refit-modes/7-hints — room tool present with hint drag on the grid to place a room (1). addRoom machine-covered in worldmodel test.
